column2: During drafts, the rankings you see will automatically be sorted by the host site's draft rankings. In each tab, the colored tabs will portray how much higher or lower the draft site has the player ranked. Typically if they're ranked higher on the site, they're going to be drafted higher, and vice versa if they are ranked lower - the site ranks influence the draft. These pages will help you during the draft to figure out if it's too early to take a player based on FantasyPros rankings.
- Insert an x to the left of player names to cross that player off, marking them as drafted.
- In order to edit the sheet, make a copy by going to File > Make a copy
- ESPN draft rankings come from their mock drafts
- Yahoo x-rank draft rankings come from their mock drafts
- Sleeper draft rankings come from BeatADP

Updated Landmine Score: A 1-10 scale rating how risky a player is in your draft room, based on how much earlier they're ranked on your platform versus expert consensus (ADP + FantasyPros), adjusted so it doesn't overreact when the gap is just position-based rather than a real disagreement.

1 = Great value
5-6 = Neutral, no real signal
10 = Landmine, avoid
